definitions.gloss: the melting of snow; thaw; snowmelt
definitions.explanation: the period when snow melts as temperatures rise, typically in spring

definitions.gloss: thaw in relations; easing of tensions
definitions.explanation: figuratively, the improvement of relations between parties who were previously hostile

notes:
SEASONAL VOCABULARY:
{雪解|ゆきど}け literally means "snow melting" and refers to the spring thaw.

SEASON:
Late winter to early spring (February-April, depending on region)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雪解|ゆきど}け⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ - snowmelt, meltwater
- {雪解|ゆきど}け⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ - road with melting snow (often muddy)
- {雪解|ゆきど}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ} - around the time of the thaw

USAGE:
The metaphor of "thaw" ({雪解|ゆきど}け) is used for:
- International relations improving (⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雪解|ゆきど}け)
- Personal relationships reconciling
- Easing of cold or hostile situations

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{融雪|ゆうせつ}→融雪：29813_yuusetsu⟧ - snowmelt (more formal/technical)
- ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧ - spring
- {霜解|しもど}け - frost thaw
